## Summary

Returns the list of `xml_schema_flat/` folders found under `S1000D_SPEC_DIR` (issue, number of XSDs, schema names). Use it to find the cause of `schema-not-found`

## Description returned by `tools/list`

This is the text an LLM receives.

> Show which S1000D XML schema folders (xml_schema_flat/ containing brex.xsd) were found under S1000D_SPEC_DIR, with the issue read from brex.xsd and the schema names available. Use it to diagnose schema-not-found results.

## Arguments

This tool takes no arguments.
